# Tests

## Basic

### Grid Genet

```{r}

# Config
grid_config <- list(Level = "Family",
                    Name = "Fabaceae",
                    Metric = "OTU",
                    Type = "genet",
                    Rar = FALSE,
                    Marker = "GH")
# Filters
grid_filters <- list(
  filter_plant = FALSE,
  filter_monocot = FALSE,
  filter_na_family = FALSE,
  filter_na_sp = FALSE,
  filter_valid_sp = FALSE
)
# Read Grid
grid <- grid_read(
  config = grid_config,
  filters = grid_filters
)
# Plot
plot_grid(grid)

```

### Grid Bota

```{r}
# Config
grid_config <- list(Level = "Family",
                    Name = "Fabaceae",
                    Type = "bota",
                    Year = "2012",
                    Metric = "OTU",
                    Radius = 10,
                    return_comm = FALSE)
# No filters
grid_filters <- list()
# Grid Read
grid <- grid_read(
  config = grid_config,
  filters = grid_filters
)
# Plot
plot_grid(grid)
```

## Others

```{r}
# Fabaceae all filters
filter_list <- list(
  filter_plant = TRUE,
  filter_monocot = TRUE,
  filter_na_family = TRUE,
  filter_na_sp = TRUE,
  filter_valid_sp = TRUE
)
grid_fam <- genet_grid_read(
  m = "GH",
  l = "Family",
  n = "Fabaceae",
  from_csv = FALSE,
  total = FALSE,
  filters = filter_list
)
plot_grid(grid_fam,"OTU")


filter_list <- list(
  filter_plant = FALSE,
  filter_monocot = FALSE,
  filter_na_family = FALSE,
  filter_na_sp = FALSE,
  filter_valid_sp = FALSE
)

patch_compare(var_bota = "H1",
              var_genet = "H1",
              b_grid = bota_grid_H1(select_tax(bota,
                                               Level = "Family",
                                               Name= "All"),
                                    R = 10),
              g_grid = genet_grid_read(m = "GH",
                                        l = "Family",
                                        n = "All",
                                        from_csv = FALSE,
                                        rarefied = FALSE,
                                        filters = filter_list,
                                        total = FALSE),
              b_f    = select_tax(bota,
                                  Level = "Family",
                                  Name= "All"),
              stems  = FALSE,
              Title = "Comparaison du nombre de Hill (q=1) de l'inventaire botanique et de l'inventaire génétique pour les dicots (reads non raréfiés)"
              )


filter_list <- list(
  filter_plant = TRUE,
  filter_monocot = TRUE,
  filter_na_family = TRUE,
  filter_na_sp = TRUE,
  filter_valid_sp = TRUE
)

patch_turbo_family(var="OTU",

                   )
```
